text.en: Cat owners regularly express confidence in the attentive care provided to boarding felines. Reviewers note that cats settle in comfortably, receive affectionate handling, and return home relaxed and undisturbed, even after extended boarding stays spanning several weeks in Balscadden.

Visitors describe the cattery as a clean, peaceful, and purpose-built environment situated in quiet rural surroundings. Clients appreciate the secure and comfortable chalets, highlighting that the setting provides reassurance for owners leaving their pets alone for the first time.

Clients warmly praise proprietors Lorna and Brian for their compassionate approach and flexibility with booking schedules. Owners appreciate receiving photo updates during boarding stays, noting that the hosts take time to understand each cat's distinct personality and habits.

q.en: Do owners receive updates while their cat is boarding?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention receiving photo messages and status updates showing their cat relaxed and content.

q.en: Where is River Cottage Cattery located?

a.en: The cattery is situated in a tranquil rural setting at Ring Commons near Balscadden in North County Dublin.

q.en: Can long-term boarding stays be accommodated?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report successful long-term stays lasting up to four weeks or more during home renovations.

q.en: Is the cattery suitable for first-time boarding cats?

a.en: Yes, multiple owners note that nervous, first-time boarding cats adapted smoothly under gentle care.
